summary: Round 2 had no findings, so nothing carried over. App.tsx: the StrictMode guard now compares the identity of the 'ending' screen object instead of the sessionId. A second effect run on the same object is still skipped. Each Leave table (a new screen object) now retries endSession, so a session whose end failed can be ended later. The sessionId still comes from the app's own screen state, not from user input. endSession stays write-once (strict readwrite transaction plus add()), so a repeat call cannot overwrite a report. A rejection still fails closed to Home with the session left resumable. e2e/session-end-retry.spec.ts patches IDBDatabase.prototype.transaction, but only inside a Playwright init script, so it adds no production surface. No new dependencies, secrets, sinks or randomness. No BLOCKER or MAJOR.
